caption: Tally: every promise to a customer, kept
say: Sales tells a customer: we'll ship single sign-on before your rollout. Then the promise is buried in a page, and nobody owns it until the customer asks. Tally keeps those promises.

caption: Tally inside Jira: 8 open, 4 at risk, 1 overdue, 1 with no owner
say: This is Tally, inside Jira. Eight open commitments. Four at risk, one overdue, and one with no owner.

caption: Every line says why, in plain words
say: Every line says why, in plain words. A blocked Jira issue. A promise confirmed two days ago that nobody owns.

caption: Discovery inbox: possible promises found in Jira and Confluence
say: Tally scans the Jira projects and Confluence spaces you choose, and lists possible promises with the exact quote.

caption: A person confirms, edits, marks ambiguous or rejects. Nothing is tracked automatically
say: A person reviews each one. The account and the date come from the quote. Nothing is tracked until someone confirms it.

caption: The evidence is the customer's own words, linked to the source
say: Here is the promise nobody owns. The evidence is the customer's own words, linked back to the Confluence page.

caption: Link the Jira work that delivers the promise
say: Link the Jira work that delivers it.

caption: Live Jira status, owner suggestions and Teamwork Graph context
say: Tally reads that issue live, suggests an owner from the people doing the work, and checks the Teamwork Graph for related work and pages.

caption: At risk: the linked Jira issue is flagged
say: This integration is at risk. Its Jira issue is flagged as blocked.

caption: Rule-based risk flags, each with its reason
say: Every risk is a rule, and Why explains it. Nine plain rules. No guessing.

caption: Risks grouped by rule, with acknowledge and expiry
say: The Risks page groups them by rule, so a lead can work through them one by one.

caption: Tally Agent in Rovo chat
say: Tally Agent works inside Rovo chat.

caption: Answers come from Tally's actions: IDs and rule reasons
say: Ask which commitments are at risk and why. It answers with commitment IDs and the rule reasons.

caption: The agent only states facts Tally returns
say: It only states facts that Tally returns. It never invents a promise.

caption: Paste a customer message: the agent proposes, you confirm
say: Paste a promise from a customer message. The agent proposes it, with the date from the quote, and you confirm before anything is saved.

caption: It lands in the Tally inbox for human review
say: It lands in the Tally inbox, for a person to review.

caption: Seven Tally tools on Atlassian's MCP server, here in Claude
say: The same seven tools are on Atlassian's MCP server, so other AI assistants, like Claude, can use them with the user's own permissions.

caption: Customer update drafted from stored facts only
say: Now draft a customer update. It is written only from stored facts.

caption: The facts it used, beside it. Copy stays disabled until approval
say: The facts it used are right beside it. Copy stays disabled until a person approves.

caption: Approve, copy into your own email, mark sent. Tally never sends
say: Approve it, copy it into your own email, and mark it sent. Tally never sends anything itself.

caption: Runs on Atlassian: checked as you, no data leaves your site
say: Everything runs on Atlassian. Jira, Confluence and the Teamwork Graph are checked as you, and no data leaves your site.

caption: Tally: Jira · Confluence · Rovo agent · MCP · Teamwork Graph
say: Tally. Every promise to a customer, kept.
